rules.rule_name: Capture Current Date for Fraud Report
rules.rule_description: The system retrieves the current system date and time at the start of fraud processing and formats it as MM/DD/YY to be used as the Fraud Report Date.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
1: Capture Current Date
Retrieve system date and time
for fraud report creation

acceptance_criteria.Given: A fraud marking process has been initiated
acceptance_criteria.When: The system begins processing the fraud report
acceptance_criteria.Then: The current system date and time are retrieved and the current date is formatted as MM/DD/YY and assigned as the Fraud Report Date (PA-FRAUD-RPT-DATE)

rules.rule_name: Construct Authorization Timestamp from Input Date and Time
rules.rule_description: The authorization timestamp is derived by parsing the original authorization date into year, month, and day components, and computing the actual authorization time using a 9's complement transformation on the input time value, then assembling all components into a full timestamp in YY-MM-DD HH24.MI.SSNNNNNN format.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
2: Format Authorization Timestamp
Convert authorization date and time
to YY-MM-DD HH24.MI.SS format

acceptance_criteria.Given: The input authorization original date (PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE) and authorization time (PA-AUTH-TIME-9C) are available
acceptance_criteria.When: The authorization timestamp is being constructed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The authorization date is parsed as: positions 1-2 = Year (YY), positions 3-4 = Month (MM), positions 5-6 = Day (DD); the authorization time is computed as 999999999 minus the input time value (PA-AUTH-TIME-9C), and the result is parsed as: positions 1-2 = Hours (HH), positions 3-4 = Minutes (MI), positions 5-6 = Seconds (SS), positions 7-9 = Milliseconds (SSS); the full authorization timestamp (AUTH-TS) is assembled from all these components in the format YY-MM-DD HH24.MI.SSNNNNNN

rules.rule_name: Map Authorization and Account Data into Fraud Record
rules.rule_description: All authorization, merchant, account, and fraud-related fields from the input data are mapped into the fraud record structure prior to database insertion.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
3: Prepare Fraud Record Data
Map all authorization fields, account ID,
customer ID, fraud action flag,
and fraud report date into fraud record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The authorization timestamp has been constructed and all input authorization data fields are available
acceptance_criteria.When: The fraud record is being prepared for storage
acceptance_criteria.Then: The following fields are mapped from input to the fraud record: Card Number (PA-CARD-NUM → CARD-NUM), Authorization Timestamp (WS-AUTH-TS → AUTH-TS), Authorization Type (PA-AUTH-TYPE → AUTH-TYPE), Card Expiry Date (PA-CARD-EXPIRY-DATE → CARD-EXPIRY-DATE), Message Type (PA-MESSAGE-TYPE → MESSAGE-TYPE), Message Source (PA-MESSAGE-SOURCE → MESSAGE-SOURCE), Authorization ID Code (PA-AUTH-ID-CODE → AUTH-ID-CODE), Authorization Response Code (PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE → AUTH-RESP-CODE), Authorization Response Reason (PA-AUTH-RESP-REASON → AUTH-RESP-REASON), Processing Code (PA-PROCESSING-CODE → PROCESSING-CODE), Transaction Amount (PA-TRANSACTION-AMT → TRANSACTION-AMT), Approved Amount (PA-APPROVED-AMT → APPROVED-AMT), Merchant Category Code (PA-MERCHANT-CATAGORY-CODE → MERCHANT-CATAGORY-CODE), Acquirer Country Code (PA-ACQR-COUNTRY-CODE → ACQR-COUNTRY-CODE), POS Entry Mode (PA-POS-ENTRY-MODE → POS-ENTRY-MODE), Merchant ID (PA-MERCHANT-ID → MERCHANT-ID), Merchant Name length and text (PA-MERCHANT-NAME → MERCHANT-NAME-LEN and MERCHANT-NAME-TEXT), Merchant City (PA-MERCHANT-CITY → MERCHANT-CITY), Merchant State (PA-MERCHANT-STATE → MERCHANT-STATE), Merchant ZIP (PA-MERCHANT-ZIP → MERCHANT-ZIP), Transaction ID (PA-TRANSACTION-ID → TRANSACTION-ID), Match Status (PA-MATCH-STATUS → MATCH-STATUS), Fraud Action Flag (WS-FRD-ACTION → AUTH-FRAUD), Account ID (WS-ACCT-ID → ACCT-ID), Customer ID (WS-CUST-ID → CUST-ID)

rules.rule_name: Insert New Fraud Authorization Record
rules.rule_description: The system attempts to insert a new fraud authorization record into the CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS table with all prepared authorization, merchant, and fraud details. The Fraud Report Date is set to the current database date at the time of insertion.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
4: Insert Fraud Authorization Record
Attempt to add new fraud record
with all authorization details

acceptance_criteria.Given: All fraud record fields have been populated from the input authorization data
acceptance_criteria.When: The system attempts to store the fraud record
acceptance_criteria.Then: A new record is inserted into the CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS table containing all fields: CARD_NUM, AUTH_TS (formatted as YY-MM-DD HH24.MI.SSNNNNNN), AUTH_TYPE, CARD_EXPIRY_DATE, MESSAGE_TYPE, MESSAGE_SOURCE, AUTH_ID_CODE, AUTH_RESP_CODE, AUTH_RESP_REASON, PROCESSING_CODE, TRANSACTION_AMT, APPROVED_AMT, MERCHANT_CATAGORY_CODE, ACQR_COUNTRY_CODE, POS_ENTRY_MODE, MERCHANT_ID, MERCHANT_NAME, MERCHANT_CITY, MERCHANT_STATE, MERCHANT_ZIP, TRANSACTION_ID, MATCH_STATUS, AUTH_FRAUD, FRAUD_RPT_DATE (set to current database date), ACCT_ID, and CUST_ID

rules.rule_name: Confirm Successful New Fraud Record Addition
rules.rule_description: When a new fraud authorization record is successfully inserted into the database, the fraud update status is marked as successful and the action message is set to indicate a successful addition.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
5: Confirm Successful Fraud Record Addition
Mark fraud update status as SUCCESS
Set action message: ADD SUCCESS

acceptance_criteria.Given: An attempt was made to insert a new fraud authorization record into CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS
acceptance_criteria.When: The insert operation completes successfully
acceptance_criteria.Then: The fraud update status is set to SUCCESS and the action message is set to 'ADD SUCCESS'

rules.rule_name: Detect Duplicate Fraud Record on Insert Failure
rules.rule_description: When a fraud record insertion fails, the system determines whether the failure is due to a duplicate record already existing for the same Card Number and Authorization Timestamp, or due to another type of error.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Insert
Successful?

acceptance_criteria.Given: An attempt to insert a new fraud authorization record into CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS has failed
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the reason for the insert failure
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the failure is caused by a duplicate record (error code -803, meaning a record with the same Card Number and Authorization Timestamp already exists), the system proceeds to update the existing fraud record; otherwise, if the failure is due to any other error, the system reports a fraud operation failure for the insert

rules.rule_name: Update Fraud Action Flag on Existing Fraud Record
rules.rule_description: When a fraud record already exists for a given Card Number and Authorization Timestamp, only the Fraud Action Flag and the Fraud Report Date are updated. All other authorization and merchant details remain unchanged.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
7: Update Existing Fraud Record
Update fraud action flag and
fraud report date for matching
card number and authorization timestamp

acceptance_criteria.Given: A fraud authorization record already exists in CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS for the same Card Number and Authorization Timestamp
acceptance_criteria.When: The system processes a fraud update for that card and authorization
acceptance_criteria.Then: Only the AUTH_FRAUD field is updated with the new fraud action flag value and the FRAUD_RPT_DATE is updated to the current database date, for the record matching both CARD_NUM and AUTH_TS (formatted as YY-MM-DD HH24.MI.SSNNNNNN); all other fields in the existing record remain unchanged

rules.rule_name: Confirm Successful Fraud Record Update
rules.rule_description: When an existing fraud authorization record is successfully updated with the new fraud action flag and report date, the fraud update status is marked as successful and the action message is set to indicate a successful update.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
8: Confirm Successful Fraud Record Update
Mark fraud update status as SUCCESS
Set action message: UPDT SUCCESS

acceptance_criteria.Given: An attempt was made to update an existing fraud authorization record in CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS
acceptance_criteria.When: The update operation completes successfully
acceptance_criteria.Then: The fraud update status is set to SUCCESS and the action message is set to 'UPDT SUCCESS'

rules.rule_name: Report Fraud Operation Failure on Update Error
rules.rule_description: When an attempt to update an existing fraud record fails due to a database error, the fraud update status is marked as failed and the error details including the database error code and state are captured into the action message.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
9: Report Fraud Operation Failure - Update
Mark fraud update status as FAILED
Capture SQL error code and state
into action message

acceptance_criteria.Given: An attempt was made to update an existing fraud authorization record in CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS
acceptance_criteria.When: The update operation fails due to a database error
acceptance_criteria.Then: The fraud update status is set to FAILED, the database error code (SQLCODE) is captured into WS-SQLCODE, the database state (SQLSTATE) is captured into WS-SQLSTATE, and the action message is set to 'UPDT ERROR DB2: CODE: [error code], STATE: [error state]'

rules.rule_name: Report Fraud Operation Failure on Insert Error
rules.rule_description: When an attempt to insert a new fraud record fails due to a database error other than a duplicate record, the fraud update status is marked as failed and the error details including the database error code and state are captured into the action message.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
9: Report Fraud Operation Failure - Insert
Mark fraud update status as FAILED
Capture SQL error code and state
into action message

acceptance_criteria.Given: An attempt was made to insert a new fraud authorization record into CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS and the failure is not due to a duplicate record
acceptance_criteria.When: The insert operation fails due to a non-duplicate database error
acceptance_criteria.Then: The fraud update status is set to FAILED, the database error code (SQLCODE) is captured into WS-SQLCODE, the database state (SQLSTATE) is captured into WS-SQLSTATE, and the action message is set to 'SYSTEM ERROR DB2: CODE: [error code], STATE: [error state]'

rules.rule_name: Return Fraud Processing Result to Calling Program
rules.rule_description: Upon completion of all fraud processing steps — whether successful insertion, successful update, or failure — the program returns control to the calling program along with the fraud update status and the corresponding action message.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
10: Return Fraud Processing Result
Return control to calling program
with fraud update status and
corresponding action message

acceptance_criteria.Given: All fraud processing steps have been completed, resulting in either a SUCCESS status with message 'ADD SUCCESS' or 'UPDT SUCCESS', or a FAILED status with a corresponding error message
acceptance_criteria.When: The fraud marking process has finished
acceptance_criteria.Then: Control is returned to the calling program with the fraud update status (SUCCESS or FAILED) and the corresponding action message (ADD SUCCESS, UPDT SUCCESS, or the error detail message)

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Current System Date and Time for Fraud Reporting
rules.rule_description: When a fraud report is being created, the system must capture the current date and time from the system clock to establish an accurate timestamp for the fraud report creation event.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Request Current System Date and Time

acceptance_criteria.Given: A fraud report creation process has been initiated and the system needs to record the date and time of the fraud reporting event
acceptance_criteria.When: The system requests the current absolute date and time from the system clock
acceptance_criteria.Then: The current system absolute time is retrieved and stored in the working time field (WS-ABS-TIME) for subsequent date formatting

rules.rule_name: Format Current Date into MM/DD/YY Structure with Date Separator
rules.rule_description: The raw system absolute time must be converted into a human-readable date format (MM/DD/YY) with a date separator character between each date component, to be used as the Fraud Report Date.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Format Date into MM/DD/YY Structure with Date Separator

acceptance_criteria.Given: The current system absolute time (WS-ABS-TIME) has been successfully retrieved from the system clock

rules.rule_name: Store Formatted Date as the Official Fraud Report Date
rules.rule_description: The formatted current date must be officially recorded as the Fraud Report Date, establishing the date on which the fraud report is being created. This date will be persisted with the fraud record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Store Formatted Date as Fraud Report Date

acceptance_criteria.Given: The current system date has been successfully formatted into MM/DD/YY structure with date separators and is available in the current date field (WS-CUR-DATE)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system assigns the formatted current date to the Fraud Report Date field
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Fraud Report Date (PA-FRAUD-RPT-DATE) is set to the formatted current system date (WS-CUR-DATE), making it available for inclusion in the fraud record being created

rules.rule_name: Extract Year Component from Authorization Date
rules.rule_description: The two-digit year is extracted from the first two characters of the incoming authorization original date field to be used in constructing the authorization timestamp for fraud record storage.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Extract Year from Authorization Date
Positions 1-2 of incoming authorization date

acceptance_criteria.Given: An incoming authorization record contains an original authorization date in the field PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE
acceptance_criteria.When: The authorization timestamp is being constructed for fraud record storage
acceptance_criteria.Then: The two-digit year value is extracted from positions 1 through 2 of the authorization original date field and stored as the year component (WS-AUTH-YY) of the authorization timestamp

rules.rule_name: Extract Month Component from Authorization Date
rules.rule_description: The two-digit month is extracted from positions 3 and 4 of the incoming authorization original date field to be used in constructing the authorization timestamp for fraud record storage.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:

Positions 3-4 of incoming authorization date

acceptance_criteria.Given: An incoming authorization record contains an original authorization date in the field PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE
acceptance_criteria.When: The authorization timestamp is being constructed for fraud record storage
acceptance_criteria.Then: The two-digit month value is extracted from positions 3 through 4 of the authorization original date field and stored as the month component (WS-AUTH-MM) of the authorization timestamp

rules.rule_name: Extract Day Component from Authorization Date

acceptance_criteria.Given: An incoming authorization record contains an original authorization date in the field PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE
acceptance_criteria.When: The authorization timestamp is being constructed for fraud record storage
acceptance_criteria.Then: The two-digit day value is extracted from positions 5 through 6 of the authorization original date field and stored as the day component (WS-AUTH-DD) of the authorization timestamp

rules.rule_name: Derive Actual Authorization Time via Complement Calculation
rules.rule_description: The incoming authorization time is stored in an encoded (complemented) format. The actual authorization time must be derived by subtracting the encoded time value from 999999999. This reversal of the complement encoding recovers the true authorization time for use in the timestamp.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Derive Time Value
Calculate actual time by computing
complement of encoded authorization time
999999999 minus encoded time value

acceptance_criteria.Given: An incoming authorization record contains an encoded authorization time value in the field PA-AUTH-TIME-9C
acceptance_criteria.When: The actual authorization time is being derived for timestamp construction
acceptance_criteria.Then: The actual authorization time (WS-AUTH-TIME) is calculated as 999999999 minus the encoded authorization time value (PA-AUTH-TIME-9C), effectively reversing the complement encoding to recover the true time

rules.rule_name: Extract Hours Component from Derived Authorization Time

acceptance_criteria.When: The time components are being parsed for timestamp assembly
acceptance_criteria.Then: The two-digit hours value is extracted from positions 1 through 2 of the derived time string and stored as the hours component (WS-AUTH-HH) of the authorization timestamp

rules.rule_name: Extract Minutes Component from Derived Authorization Time

acceptance_criteria.Given: The actual authorization time has been derived via the complement calculation and is available as a character string in WS-AUTH-TIME-AN
acceptance_criteria.When: The time components are being parsed for timestamp assembly
acceptance_criteria.Then: The two-digit minutes value is extracted from positions 3 through 4 of the derived time string and stored as the minutes component (WS-AUTH-MI) of the authorization timestamp

rules.rule_name: Extract Seconds Component from Derived Authorization Time
rules.rule_description: The two-digit seconds value is extracted from positions 5 and 6 of the derived authorization time string to be used as the seconds component of the authorization timestamp.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:

acceptance_criteria.Given: The actual authorization time has been derived via the complement calculation and is available as a character string in WS-AUTH-TIME-AN
acceptance_criteria.When: The time components are being parsed for timestamp assembly
acceptance_criteria.Then: The two-digit seconds value is extracted from positions 5 through 6 of the derived time string and stored as the seconds component (WS-AUTH-SS) of the authorization timestamp

rules.rule_name: Extract Sub-Seconds Component from Derived Authorization Time
rules.rule_description: The three-digit sub-seconds (milliseconds) value is extracted from positions 7 through 9 of the derived authorization time string to be used as the fractional seconds component of the authorization timestamp.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Extract Sub-Seconds from Derived Time
Positions 7-9 of calculated time

acceptance_criteria.Given: The actual authorization time has been derived via the complement calculation and is available as a character string in WS-AUTH-TIME-AN
acceptance_criteria.When: The time components are being parsed for timestamp assembly
acceptance_criteria.Then: The three-digit sub-seconds value is extracted from positions 7 through 9 of the derived time string and stored as the sub-seconds component (WS-AUTH-SSS) of the authorization timestamp

rules.rule_name: Assemble Final Authorization Timestamp for Fraud Record Storage
rules.rule_description: All extracted date and time components (year, month, day, hours, minutes, seconds, sub-seconds) are combined into a single formatted authorization timestamp in the format YY-MM-DD HH24.MI.SSNNNNNN. This complete timestamp is then stored in the fraud record in the authorization fraud database table.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:

Combine all components into
formatted timestamp YY-MM-DD HH24.MI.SS
ready for fraud record storage

rules.rule_name: Authorization Timestamp Construction and Formatting for Fraud Record
rules.rule_description: The authorization timestamp is derived from the original authorization date and time in the input data. The time undergoes a 9's complement transformation to reconstruct the actual authorization time, and the full timestamp is formatted as YY-MM-DD HH24.MI.SSNNNNNN before being stored in the fraud record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Include Authorization Timestamp Formatted as YY-MM-DD HH24.MI.SS

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization fraud record is being prepared for insertion and the input contains an authorization original date (PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE) and authorization time (PA-AUTH-TIME-9C)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system constructs the authorization timestamp
acceptance_criteria.Then: The authorization date components must be extracted as: Year (YY) from positions 1-2 of PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE, Month (MM) from positions 3-4, and Day (DD) from positions 5-6; AND the authorization time must be computed as 999999999 minus PA-AUTH-TIME-9C to derive the actual time; AND the time components must be extracted as: Hours (HH) from positions 1-2, Minutes (MI) from positions 3-4, Seconds (SS) from positions 5-6, and Milliseconds (SSS) from positions 7-9 of the computed time; AND the assembled timestamp (AUTH-TS) must be stored in the fraud record formatted as 'YY-MM-DD HH24.MI.SSNNNNNN'

Locate Existing Fraud Record
Match by Card Number
AND Authorization Timestamp

acceptance_criteria.Given: A fraud authorization record exists in the AUTHFRDS table and the system has a Card Number and an Authorization Timestamp derived from the input authorization data
acceptance_criteria.When: The system attempts to update the fraud record and searches the AUTHFRDS table using Card Number AND Authorization Timestamp as the composite match criteria
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system locates the exact existing fraud authorization record that matches both the Card Number and the Authorization Timestamp, and that record is selected for update

rules.rule_name: Apply Fraud Action Flag Update to Existing Fraud Record
rules.rule_description: When an existing fraud authorization record is found, only the Fraud Action Flag is updated with the current fraud action decision. All other authorization and merchant details on the record remain unchanged.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Apply Fraud Updates to Matched Record
- Set Fraud Action Flag to current fraud action
- Set Fraud Report Date to today's date

acceptance_criteria.Given: An existing fraud authorization record has been located in the AUTHFRDS table matching the Card Number and Authorization Timestamp
acceptance_criteria.When: The system applies the fraud update to the matched record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Fraud Action Flag (AUTH_FRAUD) on the matched record is set to the current fraud action value (WS-FRD-ACTION), and no other fields on the record are modified

rules.rule_name: Set Fraud Report Date to Current Date on Update
rules.rule_description: When an existing fraud authorization record is updated, the Fraud Report Date must always be set to the current system date at the time of the update, regardless of any date provided in the input data.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Apply Fraud Updates to Matched Record
- Set Fraud Action Flag to current fraud action
- Set Fraud Report Date to today's date

acceptance_criteria.Given: An existing fraud authorization record has been located in the AUTHFRDS table matching the Card Number and Authorization Timestamp
acceptance_criteria.When: The system applies the fraud update to the matched record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Fraud Report Date (FRAUD_RPT_DATE) on the matched record is set to today's current database date, overwriting any previously stored fraud report date

rules.rule_name: Mark Fraud Update Operation as Successful
rules.rule_description: When the fraud authorization record is successfully updated in the AUTHFRDS table, the system must record the outcome as a success and set the corresponding action message to confirm the update was completed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Mark Fraud Update Status as SUCCESS
Set Action Message: UPDT SUCCESS

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has attempted to update an existing fraud authorization record in the AUTHFRDS table
acceptance_criteria.When: The update operation completes successfully with no errors
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Fraud Update Status is marked as SUCCESS and the Action Message is set to 'UPDT SUCCESS'

rules.rule_name: Mark Fraud Update Operation as Failed and Capture Error Details
rules.rule_description: When the fraud authorization record update fails due to a system error, the system must record the outcome as a failure and capture the specific database error code and state into the action message for reporting and diagnosis.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Mark Fraud Update Status as FAILED
Capture Error Details into Action Message

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has attempted to update an existing fraud authorization record in the AUTHFRDS table
acceptance_criteria.When: The update operation fails due to a database or system error
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Fraud Update Status is marked as FAILED, the database error code (SQLCODE) and error state (SQLSTATE) are captured, and the Action Message is set to 'UPDT ERROR DB2: CODE: [error code], STATE: [error state]'

rules.rule_name: Evaluate Fraud Record Update Outcome
rules.rule_description: After the fraud record update operation completes in the database, the system evaluates whether the update was applied successfully to determine the next course of action.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Was the Fraud Record Updated Successfully?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A fraud record update operation has been attempted on the AUTHFRDS table for a matching Card Number and Authorization Timestamp
acceptance_criteria.When: The database update operation completes and returns a result
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system evaluates the database return status: if the update completed without errors (return code equals zero), the process proceeds to mark the fraud update as successful; if the update encountered an error (return code is non-zero), the process proceeds to the failure handling path

rules.rule_name: Mark Fraud Update Status as Successful
rules.rule_description: When the fraud record update operation completes successfully in the database, the system marks the overall fraud update processing status as successful so that the calling process is informed of the positive outcome.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Mark Fraud Update Status as SUCCESS

acceptance_criteria.Given: A fraud record update operation has been attempted on the AUTHFRDS table for a matching Card Number and Authorization Timestamp
acceptance_criteria.When: The database update operation completes without any errors (return code equals zero)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The fraud update processing status indicator (WS-FRD-UPDT-SUCCESS) is set to TRUE, signaling to the calling process that the fraud record was successfully updated

rules.rule_name: Set Fraud Update Action Confirmation Message
rules.rule_description: Upon a successful fraud record update, the system sets a human-readable confirmation message to communicate the successful update outcome back to the calling process or user interface.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Action Message to 'UPDT SUCCESS'

acceptance_criteria.Given: The fraud record update operation has completed successfully in the AUTHFRDS table and the fraud update status has been marked as successful
acceptance_criteria.When: The system confirms the update was applied without errors (return code equals zero)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The fraud action message field (WS-FRD-ACT-MSG) is populated with the value 'UPDT SUCCESS', providing a clear confirmation that the existing fraud record was located and updated successfully

rules.rule_name: Determine Which Fraud Database Operation Failed
rules.rule_description: When a fraud database operation fails, the system determines whether the failure originated from an insert attempt or an update attempt, in order to route to the appropriate error handling path.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Which Operation Failed?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A fraud database operation has failed and the failure is not due to a duplicate record condition
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates whether the failed operation was an insert of a new fraud record or an update of an existing fraud record
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the failure occurred during an insert operation, the system routes to the insert error handling path; if the failure occurred during an update operation, the system routes to the update error handling path

rules.rule_name: Capture Insert Operation Error Details
rules.rule_description: When a new fraud record insert operation fails for a reason other than a duplicate record, the system captures the database error code and error state from the failed insert attempt to support error reporting.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Capture Insert Error Details
Record SQL Error Code
and SQL State from
failed insert attempt

acceptance_criteria.Given: An attempt to insert a new fraud record into the authorization fraud database has failed and the failure is not caused by a duplicate record (i.e., the error is not a duplicate key violation)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system processes the insert failure
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system records the database error code (SQL Code) into the working error code field and records the database error state (SQL State) into the working error state field, preserving both values for inclusion in the error message

rules.rule_name: Build Insert Failure Action Message
rules.rule_description: After capturing the error details from a failed fraud record insert, the system constructs a descriptive failure message combining the error code and error state, formatted as 'SYSTEM ERROR DB2: CODE: [code], STATE: [state]', to be returned to the calling program.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Build Insert Failure Message
Combine error code and state
into action message:

acceptance_criteria.Given: The database error code and database error state have been captured from a failed fraud record insert operation
acceptance_criteria.When: The system builds the failure action message
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system constructs the action message by combining the literal text 'SYSTEM ERROR DB2: CODE:' with the captured error code value, followed by ', STATE: ' and the captured error state value, and stores this combined message in the fraud action message field to be returned to the caller

rules.rule_name: Mark Fraud Update Status as Failed After Insert Error
rules.rule_description: When a fraud record insert operation fails for a reason other than a duplicate record, the overall fraud update status must be marked as failed so the calling program is informed that the fraud reporting operation was unsuccessful.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Mark Fraud Update Status
as FAILED

acceptance_criteria.Given: A fraud record insert operation has failed for a reason other than a duplicate record, and the error details and failure message have been captured
acceptance_criteria.When: The system finalizes the insert error handling
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the fraud update status indicator to FAILED, signaling to the caller that the fraud record was not successfully added to the database

rules.rule_name: Capture Update Operation Error Details
rules.rule_description: When an attempt to update an existing fraud record fails, the system captures the database error code and error state from the failed update attempt to support error reporting.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Capture Update Error Details
Record SQL Error Code
and SQL State from
failed update attempt

acceptance_criteria.Given: An attempt to update an existing fraud record in the authorization fraud database (identified by Card Number and Authorization Timestamp) has failed
acceptance_criteria.When: The system processes the update failure
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system records the database error code (SQL Code) into the working error code field and records the database error state (SQL State) into the working error state field, preserving both values for inclusion in the error message

rules.rule_name: Build Update Failure Action Message
rules.rule_description: After capturing the error details from a failed fraud record update, the system constructs a descriptive failure message combining the error code and error state, formatted as 'UPDT ERROR DB2: CODE: [code], STATE: [state]', to be returned to the calling program.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Build Update Failure Message
Combine error code and state
into action message:
UPDT ERROR DB2: CODE, STATE

acceptance_criteria.Given: The database error code and database error state have been captured from a failed fraud record update operation
acceptance_criteria.When: The system builds the update failure action message
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system constructs the action message by combining the literal text 'UPDT ERROR DB2: CODE:' with the captured error code value, followed by ', STATE: ' and the captured error state value, and stores this combined message in the fraud action message field to be returned to the caller

rules.rule_name: Mark Fraud Update Status as Failed After Update Error
rules.rule_description: When a fraud record update operation fails, the overall fraud update status must be marked as failed so the calling program is informed that the fraud reporting operation was unsuccessful.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Mark Fraud Update Status
as FAILED

acceptance_criteria.Given: A fraud record update operation has failed and the error details and failure message have been captured
acceptance_criteria.When: The system finalizes the update error handling
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the fraud update status indicator to FAILED, signaling to the caller that the existing fraud record was not successfully updated in the database

rules.rule_name: Return Failure Status and Error Message to Caller
rules.rule_description: After marking the fraud update status as failed and building the appropriate error message (from either an insert or update failure path), the system returns control to the calling program along with the failure status and descriptive error message.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Return Failure Status
and Error Message
to Caller

acceptance_criteria.Given: The fraud update status has been marked as FAILED and the appropriate error action message has been constructed (either 'SYSTEM ERROR DB2: CODE, STATE' for insert failures or 'UPDT ERROR DB2: CODE, STATE' for update failures)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system completes the error handling process
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system returns control to the calling program with the fraud update status set to FAILED and the fraud action message field populated with the descriptive error details, enabling the caller to communicate the failure to the end user
