rules.rule_name: Mark Fraud Record Addition as Successful
rules.rule_description: When a new fraud record is successfully added to the authorization fraud database, the fraud update status is set to SUCCESS and the action message is set to 'ADD SUCCESS' to indicate a new fraud record was created.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Fraud Update Status: SUCCESS
Action Message: ADD SUCCESS
or UPDT SUCCESS

acceptance_criteria.Given: A fraud marking operation has been initiated for a card authorization record that does not yet exist in the authorization fraud database
acceptance_criteria.When: The new fraud record is successfully inserted into the authorization fraud database with all card, transaction, merchant, and fraud details
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Fraud Update Status must be set to SUCCESS and the Action Message must be set to 'ADD SUCCESS' to confirm that a new fraud record was created

rules.rule_name: Mark Fraud Record Update as Successful
rules.rule_description: When an existing fraud record is successfully updated in the authorization fraud database (because the record already existed), the fraud update status is set to SUCCESS and the action message is set to 'UPDT SUCCESS' to indicate an existing fraud record was updated.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Fraud Update Status: SUCCESS
Action Message: ADD SUCCESS
or UPDT SUCCESS

acceptance_criteria.Given: A fraud marking operation has been initiated for a card authorization record that already exists in the authorization fraud database, identified by the combination of Card Number and Authorization Timestamp
acceptance_criteria.When: The existing fraud record is successfully updated with the new fraud indicator flag and the current fraud report date
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Fraud Update Status must be set to SUCCESS and the Action Message must be set to 'UPDT SUCCESS' to confirm that an existing fraud record was updated

rules.rule_name: Mark Fraud Record Addition as Failed Due to System Error
rules.rule_description: When a new fraud record cannot be inserted into the authorization fraud database due to a system error (other than a duplicate record), the fraud update status is set to FAILED and the action message captures the specific database error code and error state to identify the cause of failure.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Fraud Update Status: FAILED
Action Message: Contains
DB2 Error Code and State

acceptance_criteria.Given: A fraud marking operation has been initiated to insert a new fraud record into the authorization fraud database
acceptance_criteria.When: The insertion fails due to a system error that is not caused by a duplicate record (i.e., the error is not a duplicate key violation)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Fraud Update Status must be set to FAILED, and the Action Message must be set to 'SYSTEM ERROR DB2: CODE: [error code], STATE: [error state]' containing the specific database error code and error state that caused the failure

rules.rule_name: Mark Fraud Record Update as Failed Due to System Error
rules.rule_description: When an existing fraud record cannot be updated in the authorization fraud database due to a system error, the fraud update status is set to FAILED and the action message captures the specific database error code and error state to identify the cause of failure.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Fraud Update Status: FAILED
Action Message: Contains
DB2 Error Code and State

acceptance_criteria.Given: A fraud marking operation has been initiated to update an existing fraud record in the authorization fraud database, identified by Card Number and Authorization Timestamp
acceptance_criteria.When: The update of the fraud indicator flag and fraud report date fails due to a system error
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Fraud Update Status must be set to FAILED, and the Action Message must be set to 'UPDT ERROR DB2: CODE: [error code], STATE: [error state]' containing the specific database error code and error state that caused the failure

rules.rule_name: Return Fraud Processing Result to Calling Program
rules.rule_description: Upon completion of the fraud marking operation — whether the record was added, updated, or failed — the fraud update status and the corresponding action message are returned to the calling program to communicate the outcome of the fraud marking operation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Return Fraud Update Status
and Action Message
to Calling Program

acceptance_criteria.Given: The fraud marking operation has completed, resulting in either a SUCCESS status with an action message of 'ADD SUCCESS' or 'UPDT SUCCESS', or a FAILED status with an action message containing the database error code and error state
acceptance_criteria.When: Control is returned to the calling program after the fraud marking operation
acceptance_criteria.Then: The calling program must receive the Fraud Update Status (SUCCESS or FAILED) and the Action Message ('ADD SUCCESS', 'UPDT SUCCESS', or the error details message) so that the outcome of the fraud marking operation is communicated back

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A fraud marking process has been initiated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system begins processing the fraud report
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current system date and time are retrieved and the current date is formatted as MM/DD/YY and assigned as the Fraud Report Date (PA-FRAUD-RPT-DATE)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Capture Current Date for Fraud Report
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system retrieves the current system date and time at the start of fraud processing and formats it as MM/DD/YY to be used as the Fraud Report Date.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The input authorization original date (PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE) and authorization time (PA-AUTH-TIME-9C) are available
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The authorization timestamp is being constructed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The authorization date is parsed as: positions 1-2 = Year (YY), positions 3-4 = Month (MM), positions 5-6 = Day (DD); the authorization time is computed as 999999999 minus the input time value (PA-AUTH-TIME-9C), and the result is parsed as: positions 1-2 = Hours (HH), positions 3-4 = Minutes (MI), positions 5-6 = Seconds (SS), positions 7-9 = Milliseconds (SSS); the full authorization timestamp (AUTH-TS) is assembled from all these components in the format YY-MM-DD HH24.MI.SSNNNNNN

all_rules.Rule_Name: Construct Authorization Timestamp from Input Date and Time
all_rules.Rule_Description: The authorization timestamp is derived by parsing the original authorization date into year, month, and day components, and computing the actual authorization time using a 9's complement transformation on the input time value, then assembling all components into a full timestamp in YY-MM-DD HH24.MI.SSNNNNNN format.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The authorization timestamp has been constructed and all input authorization data fields are available
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The fraud record is being prepared for storage
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The following fields are mapped from input to the fraud record: Card Number (PA-CARD-NUM → CARD-NUM), Authorization Timestamp (WS-AUTH-TS → AUTH-TS), Authorization Type (PA-AUTH-TYPE → AUTH-TYPE), Card Expiry Date (PA-CARD-EXPIRY-DATE → CARD-EXPIRY-DATE), Message Type (PA-MESSAGE-TYPE → MESSAGE-TYPE), Message Source (PA-MESSAGE-SOURCE → MESSAGE-SOURCE), Authorization ID Code (PA-AUTH-ID-CODE → AUTH-ID-CODE), Authorization Response Code (PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE → AUTH-RESP-CODE), Authorization Response Reason (PA-AUTH-RESP-REASON → AUTH-RESP-REASON), Processing Code (PA-PROCESSING-CODE → PROCESSING-CODE), Transaction Amount (PA-TRANSACTION-AMT → TRANSACTION-AMT), Approved Amount (PA-APPROVED-AMT → APPROVED-AMT), Merchant Category Code (PA-MERCHANT-CATAGORY-CODE → MERCHANT-CATAGORY-CODE), Acquirer Country Code (PA-ACQR-COUNTRY-CODE → ACQR-COUNTRY-CODE), POS Entry Mode (PA-POS-ENTRY-MODE → POS-ENTRY-MODE), Merchant ID (PA-MERCHANT-ID → MERCHANT-ID), Merchant Name length and text (PA-MERCHANT-NAME → MERCHANT-NAME-LEN and MERCHANT-NAME-TEXT), Merchant City (PA-MERCHANT-CITY → MERCHANT-CITY), Merchant State (PA-MERCHANT-STATE → MERCHANT-STATE), Merchant ZIP (PA-MERCHANT-ZIP → MERCHANT-ZIP), Transaction ID (PA-TRANSACTION-ID → TRANSACTION-ID), Match Status (PA-MATCH-STATUS → MATCH-STATUS), Fraud Action Flag (WS-FRD-ACTION → AUTH-FRAUD), Account ID (WS-ACCT-ID → ACCT-ID), Customer ID (WS-CUST-ID → CUST-ID)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Map Authorization and Account Data into Fraud Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: All authorization, merchant, account, and fraud-related fields from the input data are mapped into the fraud record structure prior to database insertion.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All fraud record fields have been populated from the input authorization data
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system attempts to store the fraud record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: A new record is inserted into the CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS table containing all fields: CARD_NUM, AUTH_TS (formatted as YY-MM-DD HH24.MI.SSNNNNNN), AUTH_TYPE, CARD_EXPIRY_DATE, MESSAGE_TYPE, MESSAGE_SOURCE, AUTH_ID_CODE, AUTH_RESP_CODE, AUTH_RESP_REASON, PROCESSING_CODE, TRANSACTION_AMT, APPROVED_AMT, MERCHANT_CATAGORY_CODE, ACQR_COUNTRY_CODE, POS_ENTRY_MODE, MERCHANT_ID, MERCHANT_NAME, MERCHANT_CITY, MERCHANT_STATE, MERCHANT_ZIP, TRANSACTION_ID, MATCH_STATUS, AUTH_FRAUD, FRAUD_RPT_DATE (set to current database date), ACCT_ID, and CUST_ID

all_rules.Rule_Name: Insert New Fraud Authorization Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system attempts to insert a new fraud authorization record into the CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS table with all prepared authorization, merchant, and fraud details. The Fraud Report Date is set to the current database date at the time of insertion.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An attempt was made to insert a new fraud authorization record into CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The insert operation completes successfully
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The fraud update status is set to SUCCESS and the action message is set to 'ADD SUCCESS'

all_rules.Rule_Name: Confirm Successful New Fraud Record Addition
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a new fraud authorization record is successfully inserted into the database, the fraud update status is marked as successful and the action message is set to indicate a successful addition.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An attempt to insert a new fraud authorization record into CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS has failed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the reason for the insert failure
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the failure is caused by a duplicate record (error code -803, meaning a record with the same Card Number and Authorization Timestamp already exists), the system proceeds to update the existing fraud record; otherwise, if the failure is due to any other error, the system reports a fraud operation failure for the insert

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect Duplicate Fraud Record on Insert Failure
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a fraud record insertion fails, the system determines whether the failure is due to a duplicate record already existing for the same Card Number and Authorization Timestamp, or due to another type of error.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A fraud authorization record already exists in CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS for the same Card Number and Authorization Timestamp
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system processes a fraud update for that card and authorization
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Only the AUTH_FRAUD field is updated with the new fraud action flag value and the FRAUD_RPT_DATE is updated to the current database date, for the record matching both CARD_NUM and AUTH_TS (formatted as YY-MM-DD HH24.MI.SSNNNNNN); all other fields in the existing record remain unchanged

all_rules.Rule_Name: Update Fraud Action Flag on Existing Fraud Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a fraud record already exists for a given Card Number and Authorization Timestamp, only the Fraud Action Flag and the Fraud Report Date are updated. All other authorization and merchant details remain unchanged.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An attempt was made to update an existing fraud authorization record in CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The update operation completes successfully
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The fraud update status is set to SUCCESS and the action message is set to 'UPDT SUCCESS'

all_rules.Rule_Name: Confirm Successful Fraud Record Update
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an existing fraud authorization record is successfully updated with the new fraud action flag and report date, the fraud update status is marked as successful and the action message is set to indicate a successful update.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An attempt was made to update an existing fraud authorization record in CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The update operation fails due to a database error
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The fraud update status is set to FAILED, the database error code (SQLCODE) is captured into WS-SQLCODE, the database state (SQLSTATE) is captured into WS-SQLSTATE, and the action message is set to 'UPDT ERROR DB2: CODE: [error code], STATE: [error state]'

all_rules.Rule_Name: Report Fraud Operation Failure on Update Error
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an attempt to update an existing fraud record fails due to a database error, the fraud update status is marked as failed and the error details including the database error code and state are captured into the action message.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An attempt was made to insert a new fraud authorization record into CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS and the failure is not due to a duplicate record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The insert operation fails due to a non-duplicate database error
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The fraud update status is set to FAILED, the database error code (SQLCODE) is captured into WS-SQLCODE, the database state (SQLSTATE) is captured into WS-SQLSTATE, and the action message is set to 'SYSTEM ERROR DB2: CODE: [error code], STATE: [error state]'

all_rules.Rule_Name: Report Fraud Operation Failure on Insert Error
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an attempt to insert a new fraud record fails due to a database error other than a duplicate record, the fraud update status is marked as failed and the error details including the database error code and state are captured into the action message.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All fraud processing steps have been completed, resulting in either a SUCCESS status with message 'ADD SUCCESS' or 'UPDT SUCCESS', or a FAILED status with a corresponding error message
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The fraud marking process has finished
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Control is returned to the calling program with the fraud update status (SUCCESS or FAILED) and the corresponding action message (ADD SUCCESS, UPDT SUCCESS, or the error detail message)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Return Fraud Processing Result to Calling Program
all_rules.Rule_Description: Upon completion of all fraud processing steps — whether successful insertion, successful update, or failure — the program returns control to the calling program along with the fraud update status and the corresponding action message.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A fraud report creation process has been initiated and the system needs to record the date and time of the fraud reporting event
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system requests the current absolute date and time from the system clock
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current system absolute time is retrieved and stored in the working time field (WS-ABS-TIME) for subsequent date formatting

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Current System Date and Time for Fraud Reporting
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a fraud report is being created, the system must capture the current date and time from the system clock to establish an accurate timestamp for the fraud report creation event.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The current system absolute time (WS-ABS-TIME) has been successfully retrieved from the system clock
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system formats the absolute time value into a date representation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The date is formatted as MM/DD/YY (Month/Day/Year) with a date separator character between each component, and the resulting formatted date is stored in the current date field (WS-CUR-DATE)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format Current Date into MM/DD/YY Structure with Date Separator
all_rules.Rule_Description: The raw system absolute time must be converted into a human-readable date format (MM/DD/YY) with a date separator character between each date component, to be used as the Fraud Report Date.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The current system date has been successfully formatted into MM/DD/YY structure with date separators and is available in the current date field (WS-CUR-DATE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system assigns the formatted current date to the Fraud Report Date field
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Fraud Report Date (PA-FRAUD-RPT-DATE) is set to the formatted current system date (WS-CUR-DATE), making it available for inclusion in the fraud record being created

all_rules.Rule_Name: Store Formatted Date as the Official Fraud Report Date
all_rules.Rule_Description: The formatted current date must be officially recorded as the Fraud Report Date, establishing the date on which the fraud report is being created. This date will be persisted with the fraud record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An incoming authorization record contains an original authorization date in the field PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The authorization timestamp is being constructed for fraud record storage
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The two-digit year value is extracted from positions 1 through 2 of the authorization original date field and stored as the year component (WS-AUTH-YY) of the authorization timestamp

all_rules.Rule_Name: Extract Year Component from Authorization Date
all_rules.Rule_Description: The two-digit year is extracted from the first two characters of the incoming authorization original date field to be used in constructing the authorization timestamp for fraud record storage.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An incoming authorization record contains an original authorization date in the field PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The authorization timestamp is being constructed for fraud record storage
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The two-digit month value is extracted from positions 3 through 4 of the authorization original date field and stored as the month component (WS-AUTH-MM) of the authorization timestamp

all_rules.Rule_Name: Extract Month Component from Authorization Date
all_rules.Rule_Description: The two-digit month is extracted from positions 3 and 4 of the incoming authorization original date field to be used in constructing the authorization timestamp for fraud record storage.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An incoming authorization record contains an original authorization date in the field PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The authorization timestamp is being constructed for fraud record storage
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The two-digit day value is extracted from positions 5 through 6 of the authorization original date field and stored as the day component (WS-AUTH-DD) of the authorization timestamp

all_rules.Rule_Name: Extract Day Component from Authorization Date
all_rules.Rule_Description: The two-digit day is extracted from positions 5 and 6 of the incoming authorization original date field to be used in constructing the authorization timestamp for fraud record storage.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An incoming authorization record contains an encoded authorization time value in the field PA-AUTH-TIME-9C
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The actual authorization time is being derived for timestamp construction
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The actual authorization time (WS-AUTH-TIME) is calculated as 999999999 minus the encoded authorization time value (PA-AUTH-TIME-9C), effectively reversing the complement encoding to recover the true time

all_rules.Rule_Name: Derive Actual Authorization Time via Complement Calculation
all_rules.Rule_Description: The incoming authorization time is stored in an encoded (complemented) format. The actual authorization time must be derived by subtracting the encoded time value from 999999999. This reversal of the complement encoding recovers the true authorization time for use in the timestamp.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The actual authorization time has been derived via the complement calculation and is available as a character string in WS-AUTH-TIME-AN
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The time components are being parsed for timestamp assembly
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The two-digit hours value is extracted from positions 1 through 2 of the derived time string and stored as the hours component (WS-AUTH-HH) of the authorization timestamp

all_rules.Rule_Name: Extract Hours Component from Derived Authorization Time
all_rules.Rule_Description: The two-digit hours value is extracted from the first two positions of the derived (complement-calculated) authorization time to be used as the hours component of the authorization timestamp.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The actual authorization time has been derived via the complement calculation and is available as a character string in WS-AUTH-TIME-AN
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The time components are being parsed for timestamp assembly
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The two-digit minutes value is extracted from positions 3 through 4 of the derived time string and stored as the minutes component (WS-AUTH-MI) of the authorization timestamp

all_rules.Rule_Name: Extract Minutes Component from Derived Authorization Time
all_rules.Rule_Description: The two-digit minutes value is extracted from positions 3 and 4 of the derived authorization time string to be used as the minutes component of the authorization timestamp.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The actual authorization time has been derived via the complement calculation and is available as a character string in WS-AUTH-TIME-AN
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The time components are being parsed for timestamp assembly
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The two-digit seconds value is extracted from positions 5 through 6 of the derived time string and stored as the seconds component (WS-AUTH-SS) of the authorization timestamp

all_rules.Rule_Name: Extract Seconds Component from Derived Authorization Time
all_rules.Rule_Description: The two-digit seconds value is extracted from positions 5 and 6 of the derived authorization time string to be used as the seconds component of the authorization timestamp.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The actual authorization time has been derived via the complement calculation and is available as a character string in WS-AUTH-TIME-AN
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The time components are being parsed for timestamp assembly
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The three-digit sub-seconds value is extracted from positions 7 through 9 of the derived time string and stored as the sub-seconds component (WS-AUTH-SSS) of the authorization timestamp

all_rules.Rule_Name: Extract Sub-Seconds Component from Derived Authorization Time
all_rules.Rule_Description: The three-digit sub-seconds (milliseconds) value is extracted from positions 7 through 9 of the derived authorization time string to be used as the fractional seconds component of the authorization timestamp.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All date components (year, month, day) and time components (hours, minutes, seconds, sub-seconds) have been successfully extracted and derived from the incoming authorization record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The final authorization timestamp is being assembled and stored into the fraud record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All components are combined into the assembled timestamp field (WS-AUTH-TS) and stored in the AUTH-TS field of the fraud record; when written to the fraud database table (AUTHFRDS), the timestamp is formatted using the pattern 'YY-MM-DD HH24.MI.SSNNNNNN' to ensure correct database timestamp representation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Assemble Final Authorization Timestamp for Fraud Record Storage
all_rules.Rule_Description: All extracted date and time components (year, month, day, hours, minutes, seconds, sub-seconds) are combined into a single formatted authorization timestamp in the format YY-MM-DD HH24.MI.SSNNNNNN. This complete timestamp is then stored in the fraud record in the authorization fraud database table.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization message is received containing a card number (PA-CARD-NUM)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the fraud record data for storage
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The card number from the authorization message (PA-CARD-NUM) is assigned to the fraud record card number field (CARD-NUM)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Map Card Number to Fraud Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The card number from the incoming authorization message is mapped into the fraud record structure to uniquely identify the card associated with the fraud report.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization timestamp (WS-AUTH-TS) has been constructed from the authorization original date and computed time components (year, month, day, hours, minutes, seconds, milliseconds)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the fraud record data for storage
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The constructed authorization timestamp (WS-AUTH-TS) is assigned to the fraud record authorization timestamp field (AUTH-TS)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Map Authorization Timestamp to Fraud Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The constructed authorization timestamp, derived from the original authorization date and time, is mapped into the fraud record to precisely identify when the authorization occurred.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization message is received containing an authorization type (PA-AUTH-TYPE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the fraud record data for storage
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The authorization type from the authorization message (PA-AUTH-TYPE) is assigned to the fraud record authorization type field (AUTH-TYPE)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Map Authorization Type to Fraud Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The authorization type from the incoming authorization message is mapped into the fraud record to classify the type of authorization being reported.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization message is received containing a card expiry date (PA-CARD-EXPIRY-DATE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the fraud record data for storage
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The card expiry date from the authorization message (PA-CARD-EXPIRY-DATE) is assigned to the fraud record card expiry date field (CARD-EXPIRY-DATE)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Map Card Expiry Date to Fraud Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The card expiry date from the incoming authorization message is mapped into the fraud record to capture the card validity period at the time of the authorization.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization message is received containing an authorization ID code (PA-AUTH-ID-CODE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the fraud record data for storage
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The authorization ID code from the authorization message (PA-AUTH-ID-CODE) is assigned to the fraud record authorization ID code field (AUTH-ID-CODE)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Map Authorization ID Code to Fraud Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The authorization ID code from the incoming authorization message is mapped into the fraud record to capture the unique identifier assigned to the authorization.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization message is received containing a message type (PA-MESSAGE-TYPE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the fraud record data for storage
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The message type from the authorization message (PA-MESSAGE-TYPE) is assigned to the fraud record message type field (MESSAGE-TYPE)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Map Message Type to Fraud Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The message type from the incoming authorization message is mapped into the fraud record to classify the category of the authorization message.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization message is received containing a message source (PA-MESSAGE-SOURCE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the fraud record data for storage
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The message source from the authorization message (PA-MESSAGE-SOURCE) is assigned to the fraud record message source field (MESSAGE-SOURCE)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Map Message Source to Fraud Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The message source from the incoming authorization message is mapped into the fraud record to identify the origin of the authorization message.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization message is received containing an authorization response code (PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the fraud record data for storage
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The authorization response code from the authorization message (PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE) is assigned to the fraud record authorization response code field (AUTH-RESP-CODE)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Map Authorization Response Code to Fraud Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The authorization response code from the incoming authorization message is mapped into the fraud record to capture the response decision made at the time of authorization.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization message is received containing an authorization response reason (PA-AUTH-RESP-REASON)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the fraud record data for storage
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The authorization response reason from the authorization message (PA-AUTH-RESP-REASON) is assigned to the fraud record authorization response reason field (AUTH-RESP-REASON)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Map Authorization Response Reason to Fraud Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The authorization response reason from the incoming authorization message is mapped into the fraud record to capture the detailed reason behind the authorization response.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization message is received containing a processing code (PA-PROCESSING-CODE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the fraud record data for storage
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The processing code from the authorization message (PA-PROCESSING-CODE) is assigned to the fraud record processing code field (PROCESSING-CODE)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Map Processing Code to Fraud Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The processing code from the incoming authorization message is mapped into the fraud record to identify the type of transaction processing applied.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization message is received containing a transaction amount (PA-TRANSACTION-AMT)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the fraud record data for storage
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The transaction amount from the authorization message (PA-TRANSACTION-AMT) is assigned to the fraud record transaction amount field (TRANSACTION-AMT)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Map Transaction Amount to Fraud Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The original transaction amount from the incoming authorization message is mapped into the fraud record to capture the monetary value of the transaction being reported for fraud.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization message is received containing an approved amount (PA-APPROVED-AMT)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the fraud record data for storage
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The approved amount from the authorization message (PA-APPROVED-AMT) is assigned to the fraud record approved amount field (APPROVED-AMT)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Map Approved Amount to Fraud Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The approved amount from the incoming authorization message is mapped into the fraud record to capture the monetary value that was approved at the time of authorization.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization message is received containing a merchant category code (PA-MERCHANT-CATAGORY-CODE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the fraud record data for storage
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The merchant category code from the authorization message (PA-MERCHANT-CATAGORY-CODE) is assigned to the fraud record merchant category code field (MERCHANT-CATAGORY-CODE)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Map Merchant Category Code to Fraud Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The merchant category code from the incoming authorization message is mapped into the fraud record to classify the type of business where the transaction occurred.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization message is received containing an acquirer country code (PA-ACQR-COUNTRY-CODE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the fraud record data for storage
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The acquirer country code from the authorization message (PA-ACQR-COUNTRY-CODE) is assigned to the fraud record acquirer country code field (ACQR-COUNTRY-CODE)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Map Acquirer Country Code to Fraud Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The acquirer country code from the incoming authorization message is mapped into the fraud record to identify the country of the acquiring institution involved in the transaction.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization message is received containing a POS entry mode (PA-POS-ENTRY-MODE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the fraud record data for storage
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The POS entry mode from the authorization message (PA-POS-ENTRY-MODE) is assigned to the fraud record POS entry mode field (POS-ENTRY-MODE)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Map POS Entry Mode to Fraud Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Point-of-Sale entry mode from the incoming authorization message is mapped into the fraud record to capture how the card data was entered at the point of sale (e.g., swiped, keyed, chip).

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization message is received containing a merchant ID (PA-MERCHANT-ID)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the fraud record data for storage
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The merchant ID from the authorization message (PA-MERCHANT-ID) is assigned to the fraud record merchant ID field (MERCHANT-ID)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Map Merchant ID to Fraud Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The merchant identifier from the incoming authorization message is mapped into the fraud record to uniquely identify the merchant where the transaction took place.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization message is received containing a merchant name (PA-MERCHANT-NAME)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the fraud record data for storage
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The length of the merchant name field (PA-MERCHANT-NAME) is assigned to the merchant name length field (MERCHANT-NAME-LEN), and the merchant name text from the authorization message (PA-MERCHANT-NAME) is assigned to the fraud record merchant name text field (MERCHANT-NAME-TEXT)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Map Merchant Name to Fraud Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The merchant name from the incoming authorization message is mapped into the fraud record, including the name length and name text, to identify the merchant by name in the fraud report.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization message is received containing a merchant city (PA-MERCHANT-CITY)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the fraud record data for storage
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The merchant city from the authorization message (PA-MERCHANT-CITY) is assigned to the fraud record merchant city field (MERCHANT-CITY)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Map Merchant City to Fraud Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The merchant city from the incoming authorization message is mapped into the fraud record to capture the city location of the merchant where the transaction occurred.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization message is received containing a merchant state (PA-MERCHANT-STATE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the fraud record data for storage
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The merchant state from the authorization message (PA-MERCHANT-STATE) is assigned to the fraud record merchant state field (MERCHANT-STATE)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Map Merchant State to Fraud Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The merchant state from the incoming authorization message is mapped into the fraud record to capture the state location of the merchant where the transaction occurred.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization message is received containing a merchant ZIP code (PA-MERCHANT-ZIP)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the fraud record data for storage
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The merchant ZIP code from the authorization message (PA-MERCHANT-ZIP) is assigned to the fraud record merchant ZIP field (MERCHANT-ZIP)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Map Merchant ZIP Code to Fraud Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The merchant ZIP code from the incoming authorization message is mapped into the fraud record to capture the postal location of the merchant where the transaction occurred.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization message is received containing a transaction ID (PA-TRANSACTION-ID)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the fraud record data for storage
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The transaction ID from the authorization message (PA-TRANSACTION-ID) is assigned to the fraud record transaction ID field (TRANSACTION-ID)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Map Transaction ID to Fraud Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The transaction identifier from the incoming authorization message is mapped into the fraud record to provide a unique reference to the specific transaction being reported for fraud.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization message is received containing a match status (PA-MATCH-STATUS)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the fraud record data for storage
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The match status from the authorization message (PA-MATCH-STATUS) is assigned to the fraud record match status field (MATCH-STATUS)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Map Match Status to Fraud Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The match status from the incoming authorization message is mapped into the fraud record to indicate whether the authorization was matched against known fraud patterns.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A fraud action decision (WS-FRD-ACTION) has been determined upstream prior to fraud record preparation
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the fraud record data for storage
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The fraud action flag (WS-FRD-ACTION) is assigned to the fraud record authorization fraud indicator field (AUTH-FRAUD)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Map Fraud Action Flag to Fraud Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The fraud action flag, representing the fraud determination decision made upstream, is mapped into the fraud record to indicate whether the authorization has been identified as fraudulent.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An account ID (WS-ACCT-ID) is available and associated with the card used in the authorization
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the fraud record data for storage
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The account ID (WS-ACCT-ID) is assigned to the fraud record account ID field (ACCT-ID)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Map Account ID to Fraud Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The account identifier is mapped into the fraud record to link the fraud report to the specific customer account associated with the card used in the authorization.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A customer ID (WS-CUST-ID) is available and associated with the account linked to the card used in the authorization
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the fraud record data for storage
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The customer ID (WS-CUST-ID) is assigned to the fraud record customer ID field (CUST-ID)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Map Customer ID to Fraud Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The customer identifier is mapped into the fraud record to link the fraud report to the specific customer who owns the account associated with the card used in the authorization.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has retrieved the current date (WS-CUR-DATE) formatted as MM/DD/YY at the start of processing
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the fraud record data for storage
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current system date (WS-CUR-DATE) is assigned to the fraud report date field (PA-FRAUD-RPT-DATE), and the database record's FRAUD_RPT_DATE column is set to the current database date (CURRENT DATE) at the time of insert or update — the fraud report date is never sourced from the input authorization message

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Fraud Report Date to Current System Date
all_rules.Rule_Description: The fraud report date is always set to the current system date at the time the fraud record is being prepared, ensuring the report date reflects when the fraud was reported rather than when the authorization occurred.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization fraud record is being prepared for insertion into the AUTHFRDS fraud authorization table
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the fraud record fields from the incoming authorization data
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Number (CARD-NUM) must be populated from the incoming authorization Card Number (PA-CARD-NUM) and included as the primary identifying field in the fraud record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Number as Primary Record Identifier for Fraud Authorization Insert
all_rules.Rule_Description: The card number from the incoming authorization data is used as the primary identifying field when preparing a new fraud authorization record for insertion into the fraud database.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization fraud record is being prepared for insertion and the input contains an authorization original date (PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE) and authorization time (PA-AUTH-TIME-9C)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system constructs the authorization timestamp
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The authorization date components must be extracted as: Year (YY) from positions 1-2 of PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE, Month (MM) from positions 3-4, and Day (DD) from positions 5-6; AND the authorization time must be computed as 999999999 minus PA-AUTH-TIME-9C to derive the actual time; AND the time components must be extracted as: Hours (HH) from positions 1-2, Minutes (MI) from positions 3-4, Seconds (SS) from positions 5-6, and Milliseconds (SSS) from positions 7-9 of the computed time; AND the assembled timestamp (AUTH-TS) must be stored in the fraud record formatted as 'YY-MM-DD HH24.MI.SSNNNNNN'

all_rules.Rule_Name: Authorization Timestamp Construction and Formatting for Fraud Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The authorization timestamp is derived from the original authorization date and time in the input data. The time undergoes a 9's complement transformation to reconstruct the actual authorization time, and the full timestamp is formatted as YY-MM-DD HH24.MI.SSNNNNNN before being stored in the fraud record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization fraud record is being prepared for insertion into the AUTHFRDS table
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the authorization detail fields
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The following fields must be populated from the corresponding incoming authorization data: Authorization Type (AUTH-TYPE) from PA-AUTH-TYPE, Card Expiry Date (CARD-EXPIRY-DATE) from PA-CARD-EXPIRY-DATE, Message Type (MESSAGE-TYPE) from PA-MESSAGE-TYPE, Message Source (MESSAGE-SOURCE) from PA-MESSAGE-SOURCE, Authorization ID Code (AUTH-ID-CODE) from PA-AUTH-ID-CODE, Authorization Response Code (AUTH-RESP-CODE) from PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE, Authorization Response Reason (AUTH-RESP-REASON) from PA-AUTH-RESP-REASON, and Processing Code (PROCESSING-CODE) from PA-PROCESSING-CODE

all_rules.Rule_Name: Authorization Details Population for Fraud Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: All authorization-specific details from the incoming authorization data must be captured and included in the fraud record, covering the authorization type, card expiry, message classification, authorization identifiers, response information, and processing code.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization fraud record is being prepared for insertion into the AUTHFRDS table
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the transaction detail fields
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The following fields must be populated from the corresponding incoming authorization data: Transaction Amount (TRANSACTION-AMT) from PA-TRANSACTION-AMT, Approved Amount (APPROVED-AMT) from PA-APPROVED-AMT, Merchant Category Code (MERCHANT-CATAGORY-CODE) from PA-MERCHANT-CATAGORY-CODE, Acquirer Country Code (ACQR-COUNTRY-CODE) from PA-ACQR-COUNTRY-CODE, and POS Entry Mode (POS-ENTRY-MODE) from PA-POS-ENTRY-MODE

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Financial and Acquisition Details Population for Fraud Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: All transaction financial details and acquisition context information from the incoming authorization data must be captured and included in the fraud record, covering transaction and approved amounts, merchant category, acquirer country, and point-of-sale entry mode.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization fraud record is being prepared for insertion into the AUTHFRDS table
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the merchant detail fields
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The following fields must be populated from the corresponding incoming authorization data: Merchant ID (MERCHANT-ID) from PA-MERCHANT-ID, Merchant Name length (MERCHANT-NAME-LEN) set to the defined length of PA-MERCHANT-NAME and Merchant Name text (MERCHANT-NAME-TEXT) from PA-MERCHANT-NAME, Merchant City (MERCHANT-CITY) from PA-MERCHANT-CITY, Merchant State (MERCHANT-STATE) from PA-MERCHANT-STATE, and Merchant ZIP (MERCHANT-ZIP) from PA-MERCHANT-ZIP

all_rules.Rule_Name: Merchant Details Population for Fraud Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: All merchant identification and location details from the incoming authorization data must be captured and included in the fraud record. The merchant name is stored as a variable-length field requiring both the length and text value to be set.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization fraud record is being prepared for insertion into the AUTHFRDS table
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the additional detail fields
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The following fields must be populated from the corresponding incoming authorization data: Transaction ID (TRANSACTION-ID) from PA-TRANSACTION-ID, Match Status (MATCH-STATUS) from PA-MATCH-STATUS, Account ID (ACCT-ID) from WS-ACCT-ID, and Customer ID (CUST-ID) from WS-CUST-ID

all_rules.Rule_Name: Additional Transaction and Account Details Population for Fraud Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The transaction identifier, match status, and account/customer linkage details from the incoming authorization data must be captured and included in the fraud record to ensure full traceability.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization fraud record is being prepared for insertion into the AUTHFRDS table and a fraud action decision (WS-FRD-ACTION) has been determined upstream
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system sets the fraud classification on the record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Authorization Fraud flag (AUTH-FRAUD) must be set from the Fraud Action Indicator (WS-FRD-ACTION), capturing the fraud classification decision for this authorization

all_rules.Rule_Name: Fraud Action Flag Assignment for Fraud Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The fraud indicator flag on the fraud record must be set from the fraud action indicator determined upstream in the process, representing the fraud classification decision for this authorization.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization fraud record is being inserted into the AUTHFRDS table
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system sets the fraud report date on the new record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Fraud Report Date (FRAUD_RPT_DATE) must be set to the current database system date (CURRENT DATE) at the time of insertion, and must not be sourced from any input data field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Fraud Report Date Set to Current System Date on Record Creation
all_rules.Rule_Description: The fraud report date on a newly inserted fraud authorization record must always reflect the current system date at the time of insertion, ensuring an accurate audit trail of when the fraud was reported. This date is never sourced from the input data.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All fraud record fields have been populated from the incoming authorization data including Card Number, Authorization Timestamp, Authorization Type, Card Expiry Date, Message Type, Message Source, Authorization ID Code, Authorization Response Code, Authorization Response Reason, Processing Code, Transaction Amount, Approved Amount, Merchant Category Code, Acquirer Country Code, POS Entry Mode, Merchant ID, Merchant Name, Merchant City, Merchant State, Merchant ZIP, Transaction ID, Match Status, Fraud Action Flag, Account ID, and Customer ID
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system attempts to insert the new fraud authorization record into the CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS table
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: A new record must be inserted into CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS with all 26 fields populated; the Authorization Timestamp must be stored using the format 'YY-MM-DD HH24.MI.SSNNNNNN'; the Fraud Report Date must be set to the current database system date (CURRENT DATE); AND if the insert is successful (no error), the operation outcome must be marked as successful with the message 'ADD SUCCESS'; AND if a duplicate record already exists for the same Card Number and Authorization Timestamp, the system must invoke the Fraud Record Update process (FRAUD-UPDATE); AND if any other system error occurs, the operation must be marked as failed and the error code and error state must be captured and reported as 'SYSTEM ERROR DB2: CODE: [error code], STATE: [error state]'

all_rules.Rule_Name: New Fraud Authorization Record Insertion into AUTHFRDS Table
all_rules.Rule_Description: A new fraud authorization record is inserted into the AUTHFRDS table containing all authorization, transaction, merchant, and fraud details. The insert includes all 26 fields: card number, authorization timestamp, authorization details, transaction details, merchant details, fraud flag, fraud report date, account ID, and customer ID.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A fraud record insert operation has been attempted for a card authorization in the authorization fraud database (AUTHFRDS)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The database insert operation completes and returns a result code of zero, indicating no errors occurred
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system proceeds to mark the fraud update status as successful and set the corresponding success message; if the result code is non-zero, no success actions are taken and control returns to the main process

all_rules.Rule_Name: Verify Fraud Record Insert Operation Result
all_rules.Rule_Description: After attempting to insert a new fraud record into the authorization fraud database, the system evaluates whether the insert operation completed without errors to determine the appropriate next action.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A new fraud record insert operation has been attempted for a card authorization in the authorization fraud database (AUTHFRDS)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The database insert operation completes successfully with no errors (result code equals zero)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The fraud update status flag (WS-FRD-UPDT-SUCCESS) is set to TRUE, indicating the fraud record was successfully added to the database

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mark Fraud Record Addition as Successful
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a new fraud record is successfully inserted into the authorization fraud database, the system updates the fraud update status indicator to reflect a successful outcome, enabling downstream processes to recognize the operation completed correctly.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A new fraud record insert operation has been attempted for a card authorization in the authorization fraud database (AUTHFRDS), and the fraud update status has been marked as successful
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The database insert operation completes successfully with no errors (result code equals zero)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The fraud action message field (WS-FRD-ACT-MSG) is set to the value 'ADD SUCCESS', confirming to the calling process that a new fraud record was created successfully

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Action Message to Confirm Successful Fraud Record Addition
all_rules.Rule_Description: Upon successful insertion of a new fraud record, the system sets a human-readable action message to confirm that the fraud record addition was completed successfully, providing clear feedback to the calling process or user interface.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A fraud record insert operation has failed for a card authorization transaction, and the system needs to determine the cause of the failure
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The insert failure is caused by a duplicate record already existing in the fraud database with the same Card Number (CARD_NUM) and the same Authorization Timestamp (AUTH_TS)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system identifies the failure as a duplicate record condition and routes the processing to update the existing fraud record rather than attempting a new insert

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect Duplicate Fraud Record on Insert Failure
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a fraud record insert operation fails, the system must determine whether the failure is caused by a duplicate record already existing for the same Card Number and Authorization Timestamp combination, in order to decide the appropriate recovery action.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A fraud record insert has failed and the failure has been confirmed as a duplicate record condition, meaning a fraud record already exists for the same Card Number and Authorization Timestamp
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system detects the duplicate record condition
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system triggers the Fraud Update process (FRAUD-UPDATE) to update the existing fraud record with the new fraud indicator flag and the current date as the Fraud Report Date, instead of inserting a new record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Trigger Update of Existing Fraud Record on Duplicate Detection
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a fraud record insert fails because a record already exists for the same Card Number and Authorization Timestamp, the system must invoke the fraud record update process to update the existing record instead of creating a new one.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A fraud record insert operation has failed and the failure is NOT caused by a duplicate record condition
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system determines the insert failure is due to a different system or database error
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system marks the fraud update operation as FAILED, captures the database error code (SQLCODE) and error state (SQLSTATE), and sets the fraud action message to 'SYSTEM ERROR DB2: CODE: [error code], STATE: [error state]' to communicate the failure details back to the caller

all_rules.Rule_Name: Report Fraud Operation Failure for Non-Duplicate Errors
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a fraud record insert fails for any reason other than a duplicate record, the system must mark the fraud operation as failed and capture the specific error details including the database error code and error state for reporting purposes.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A fraud authorization record exists in the AUTHFRDS table and the system has a Card Number and an Authorization Timestamp derived from the input authorization data
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system attempts to update the fraud record and searches the AUTHFRDS table using Card Number AND Authorization Timestamp as the composite match criteria
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system locates the exact existing fraud authorization record that matches both the Card Number and the Authorization Timestamp, and that record is selected for update

all_rules.Rule_Name: Locate Existing Fraud Authorization Record by Card Number and Authorization Timestamp
all_rules.Rule_Description: When updating a fraud record, the system must uniquely identify the existing record in the fraud authorization table using the combination of Card Number and Authorization Timestamp as the composite lookup key.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An existing fraud authorization record has been located in the AUTHFRDS table matching the Card Number and Authorization Timestamp
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system applies the fraud update to the matched record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Fraud Action Flag (AUTH_FRAUD) on the matched record is set to the current fraud action value (WS-FRD-ACTION), and no other fields on the record are modified

all_rules.Rule_Name: Apply Fraud Action Flag Update to Existing Fraud Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an existing fraud authorization record is found, only the Fraud Action Flag is updated with the current fraud action decision. All other authorization and merchant details on the record remain unchanged.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An existing fraud authorization record has been located in the AUTHFRDS table matching the Card Number and Authorization Timestamp
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system applies the fraud update to the matched record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Fraud Report Date (FRAUD_RPT_DATE) on the matched record is set to today's current database date, overwriting any previously stored fraud report date

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Fraud Report Date to Current Date on Update
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an existing fraud authorization record is updated, the Fraud Report Date must always be set to the current system date at the time of the update, regardless of any date provided in the input data.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has attempted to update an existing fraud authorization record in the AUTHFRDS table
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The update operation completes successfully with no errors
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Fraud Update Status is marked as SUCCESS and the Action Message is set to 'UPDT SUCCESS'

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mark Fraud Update Operation as Successful
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the fraud authorization record is successfully updated in the AUTHFRDS table, the system must record the outcome as a success and set the corresponding action message to confirm the update was completed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has attempted to update an existing fraud authorization record in the AUTHFRDS table
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The update operation fails due to a database or system error
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Fraud Update Status is marked as FAILED, the database error code (SQLCODE) and error state (SQLSTATE) are captured, and the Action Message is set to 'UPDT ERROR DB2: CODE: [error code], STATE: [error state]'

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mark Fraud Update Operation as Failed and Capture Error Details
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the fraud authorization record update fails due to a system error, the system must record the outcome as a failure and capture the specific database error code and state into the action message for reporting and diagnosis.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A fraud record update operation has been attempted on the AUTHFRDS table for a matching Card Number and Authorization Timestamp
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The database update operation completes and returns a result
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system evaluates the database return status: if the update completed without errors (return code equals zero), the process proceeds to mark the fraud update as successful; if the update encountered an error (return code is non-zero), the process proceeds to the failure handling path

all_rules.Rule_Name: Evaluate Fraud Record Update Outcome
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the fraud record update operation completes in the database, the system evaluates whether the update was applied successfully to determine the next course of action.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A fraud record update operation has been attempted on the AUTHFRDS table for a matching Card Number and Authorization Timestamp
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The database update operation completes without any errors (return code equals zero)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The fraud update processing status indicator (WS-FRD-UPDT-SUCCESS) is set to TRUE, signaling to the calling process that the fraud record was successfully updated

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mark Fraud Update Status as Successful
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the fraud record update operation completes successfully in the database, the system marks the overall fraud update processing status as successful so that the calling process is informed of the positive outcome.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The fraud record update operation has completed successfully in the AUTHFRDS table and the fraud update status has been marked as successful
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system confirms the update was applied without errors (return code equals zero)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The fraud action message field (WS-FRD-ACT-MSG) is populated with the value 'UPDT SUCCESS', providing a clear confirmation that the existing fraud record was located and updated successfully

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Fraud Update Action Confirmation Message
all_rules.Rule_Description: Upon a successful fraud record update, the system sets a human-readable confirmation message to communicate the successful update outcome back to the calling process or user interface.

all_rules.Rule_Name: Determine Which Fraud Database Operation Failed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Capture Insert Operation Error Details

all_rules.Rule_Name: Build Insert Failure Action Message

all_rules.Rule_Name: Build Update Failure Action Message

all_rules.Rule_Name: Return Failure Status and Error Message to Caller

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mark Fraud Record Addition as Failed Due to System Error

Acceptance_Criteria.When: The update of the fraud indicator flag and fraud report date fails due to a system error

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mark Fraud Record Update as Failed Due to System Error

description:
COPAUS2C is a CICS COBOL program within the CardDemo Authorization Module that marks authorization messages as fraudulent by recording or updating fraud-related transaction details in the database. The program receives authorization record details via a COMMAREA from a calling program, formats the transaction timestamp, and either inserts a new fraud record or updates an existing one in the CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS DB2 table, returning a success or failure status to the caller.
- **Execution Environment**: Online (CICS) - **Database Access**: DB2 - **MQ Calls**: No - **Module Type**: Called module
### Key Functionalities: 1: Capture Current Date - Retrieve the current system date and time to record when the fraud report is being created 2: Format Authorization Timestamp - Convert the original authorization date and time from the incoming authorization record into a formatted timestamp (YY-MM-DD HH24.MI.SS) for storage 3: Prepare Fraud Record Data - Map all authorization message fields (card number, authorization type, card expiry date, message type, message source, authorization ID, response code, response reason, processing code, transaction amount, approved amount, merchant category code, acquirer country code, POS entry mode, merchant ID, merchant name, merchant city, merchant state, merchant ZIP, transaction ID, match status) along with account ID, customer ID, fraud action flag, and fraud report date into the fraud record structure 4: Insert Fraud Authorization Record - Attempt to insert a new fraud record into the AUTHFRDS database table with all authorization details, fraud flag, and current date as the fraud report date 5: Confirm Successful Fraud Record Addition - If the database insert succeeds, mark the fraud update status as successful and set the action message to indicate the record was added successfully 6: Handle Duplicate Fraud Record - If the insert fails due to a duplicate record (record already exists for the same card number and authorization timestamp), trigger an update of the existing fraud record instead of inserting a new one 7: Update Existing Fraud Record - Update the existing fraud authorization record in the AUTHFRDS table, setting the fraud action flag and the fraud report date to the current date, matched by card number and authorization timestamp 8: Confirm Successful Fraud Record Update - If the database update succeeds, mark the fraud update status as successful and set the action message to indicate the record was updated successfully 9: Report Fraud Operation Failure - If either the insert or update database operation fails for reasons other than a duplicate record, mark the fraud update status as failed and capture the error details (SQL code and SQL state) into the action message for the caller 10: Return Fraud Processing Result - Return control to the calling program with the fraud update status (success or failure) and the corresponding action message indicating the outcome of the fraud marking operation
